title: Lisbon opens its first night-time tram line

entities.name: Carris
entities.context: Lisbon's transport company, which runs the trams.

entities.name: Lisbon
entities.context: City where the night tram line opened.

entities.name: Remodelado
entities.context: Historic tram cars built in the 1930s.

claims.claim: Carris launched a night-time service on tram line 28.
claims.quote: Lisbon's transport company Carris launched a night-time service on tram line 28 on Monday, the first time the city's historic trams have run after midnight.

claims.claim: Carris expects around 3,000 riders a night in the first summer.
claims.quote: "We expect around 3,000 riders a night in the first summer," said Carris spokesperson João Matos.

claims.claim: The Remodelado cars were built in the 1930s.
claims.quote: The Remodelado trams were originally built in the 1930s.

claims.claim: Critics say the night service will worsen noise in Alfama.
The city council says the line is quieter than the buses it replaces.

relationships.description: Carris rebuilt the Remodelado cars in the 1990s.
relationships.quote: The trams themselves are Remodelado cars, built in the 1930s and rebuilt by Carris in the 1990s.

relationships.description: The newer trams compete for tourists with tuk-tuks.
relationships.quote: They share the line with the newer Siemens articulated trams on route 15, which compete for tourists with the citys tuk-tuk operators.

contradictions.claim: The night service will worsen noise in Alfama.
contradictions.against: The city council says the line runs quieter than the buses it replaces.

summary: Lisbon's Carris launched a night tram service on line 28.
